environment.description: Lambda function deployed with SQS trigger from queue 'oauth-callback-queue'. The SQS queue resource policy restricts sqs:SendMessage to a specific source VPC endpoint (aws:sourceVpce condition). However, the Lambda function URL is configured with AuthType: AWS_IAM and the resource-based policy on the function specifies a Condition block with StringEquals on 'lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType' set to 'AWS_IAM'. Note: the function URL's invoke policy does NOT have a wildcard principal - it grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl only to role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/api-gateway-proxy-role. The SQS queue additionally has server-side encryption (SSE-SQS) enabled and a DLQ configured with maxReceiveCount of 3.

config.vpc_config: Lambda in private subnet with NAT gateway, security group egress restricted to port 443 only to OAuth provider CIDR
